objective: Sail far north to Five Winds and climb it: leap stones wait at the foot of the southern cliffs
title: The Climb
summary: The pillars wake one nature at a time, and Kagerou has left guardians at each.

steps.title: Five Winds
steps.sub: The summit where the founders bound the Nue

say: You took the leap stones too? I screamed the whole way up. Manly screaming.

lines: Listen. The pillars are humming. One for each nature.
Guardians. Kagerou left one company of clones for each pillar, so the circle is ready when the moon goes dark.
Five pillars, five fights. Hisame isn't here yet, so we're doing something brave before she arrives again.
One nature at a time, {name}. Read each wave and answer it.
Five silent pillars. You've made his circle harder to close.
Did we do something brave before you arrived?
The light's going. When the moon is gone, he'll come. Stay together, whatever he wakes.
